assertions: Uses the Explore agent (or equivalent codebase search) to verify current database/migration setup before writing the Context section, rather than inventing it
Creates the file at docs/adr/XXXX-database-migration-strategy.md with a 4-digit ADR number one higher than the highest existing ADR (0001 if none exist)
Defaults to the Nygard template with Status, Context, Decision, and Consequences sections since no variant keyword was given
Reports the ADR number and file path back to the user
Strips the "lightweight" keyword out of the title before generating the filename and ADR title
Verifies Redis (or an equivalent session-storage mechanism) is actually referenced in the codebase before claiming it as the decision, not assumed
Uses the lightweight template variant containing only Status, Decision, and Rationale sections (no Context/Consequences)
Does not invent file paths or code snippets that were not actually found in the repo
Uses the full template variant with Decision Drivers, Considered Options, and Pros/Cons sections in addition to Status, Context, Decision, and Consequences
Consequences are split into Positive, Negative, and Neutral subsections as specified for the full variant
Gathers and cites real context (existing messaging/event code, configs, or docs found via search) rather than generic boilerplate
ADR number increments correctly from the highest existing docs/adr/XXXX-*.md file
Includes alternatives/considered options that were actually evaluated, not fabricated ones
